program_authority.title: Epic: reach first useful RAES success in ten minutes
program_authority.body_at_capture:
## Outcome

A first-time AI researcher, security researcher, resilience practitioner, product tester, or AI engineer can go from curiosity to a safe, inspectable local result in ten minutes or less, then change one thing and cleanly tear it down.

## Exit criteria

- [ ] The journey uses one discoverable, canonical entry point from the Hub.
- [ ] The default path selects a bounded environment pack and runs it on LilRAE without requiring users to understand the full ecosystem architecture.
- [ ] The run produces inspectable evidence showing what was realized and why.
- [ ] The user can change one bounded input and observe a corresponding result change.
- [ ] Teardown and rollback are explicit, safe, and verified.
- [ ] The journey is rehearsed from a clean machine against released artifacts rather than repository-relative assumptions.

## Program boundary

Hub owns the journey definition, cross-repository sequencing, and release gate. The executable path is:

1. RAES owns semantics, contracts, and conformance.
2. Catalog owns discoverable packs and reusable assets.
3. LilRAE is the complete personal/local backend generalized from APTL; it owns local realization, readiness, evidence, rollback, and teardown.
4. BigRAE is the complete organizational/SaaS backend migrated from Shifter; it owns the organizational control plane, tenancy, authentication, policy, secrets, scheduling, audit, and operations.
5. Adapters exist only where a distinct translation boundary is required.

env-packs owns the bounded quickstart pack used by this journey. The default path uses a small pack/profile on the complete LilRAE product; that profile does not define LilRAE's maximum capability.

## Existing anchors

- RAESystem/RAES#613 — contract and conformance work
- RAESystem/lilrae#1 — complete personal-backend migration epic
- RAESystem/lilrae#10 — quickstart qualification
- RAESystem/env-packs#187 — bounded quickstart environment
- RAESystem/hub#15 — advanced APTL experience
- RAESystem/hub#29 — product-direction documentation and ADR 0005

This program issue is complete when those repository-level deliverables compose into the tested journey above.

method_limitations: All 41 milestone issues inventoried; critical paths deeply reviewed; not every line of touched files inspected.
Counterexamples exercise contract and orchestration behavior, not deployed backend penetration.
No full test suite or downstream LilRAE/BigRAE implementation audit.
Touched-file counts include pre-existing code, later changes, shared files and generated schema fan-out.

interpretation_updates.authority: Project-owner clarification in the audit conversation
interpretation_updates.clarification: RAE's runtime is the shared execution engine that drives LilRAE, BigRAE, and other backends through execution. It is a product component alongside SDL and the processor, and may be the only runtime implementation built.

finding_disposition.F01: Original high-severity ownership objection withdrawn; identifier retained as a correction record.
finding_disposition.F02-F16: Retained; remediation ownership clarified around the shared runtime and concrete backend realization.

interpretation_updates.repair_direction: Preserve common orchestration in RAE; evaluate reusable foundations within or beneath the runtime and complete execution/evidence contracts with backends.
